Hello again!



Is me your lonely dev! I'm here to present to you my newest creations!



I thought to myself: "Huh, this is a survival game but there is no edible for survival" so i added some vegetables for you to eat and grow them again.



Yes this is a survival game but the term "survival" is second priority. I want my players to enjoy their creations without constant hunger.



Full Changelog:


Added Bucket: you can dip it in water then use it for plants. 

Added Tomat

Added Pepper

Added Potato

Added Leman

and their seeds too.

Changed Clouds so they become more functional like raining and stuff idk im not a cloud.



Yes it took me some time to update this game don't judge a full time [strike]slave[/strike] wage worker.

I'll see you again sometime i guess.



As i said before, this update is avaiable on "beta" branch. You can play it there.

Bye!

notes.title: The Pulse Update
notes.content:
Hello Again! Its me. Your never asked to come developer.

In previous post, I wanted your patience. And for your patience, i come with a reward!

USG gets its first update after "a few" years! Woo hoo...

Here's the stuff that changed:
- Accidentaly removed old game files
- Removed fish (will come back later.)
+ Added multiplayer (working but probably gonna fail)
+ Reworked game world
+ Reworked gravity
+ Reworked items

This update will be posted on test branch. So if you want to test it out early select the branch and enjoy. 

Here's the full changelog:

+ Change on world script so its round now.
+ Change on gravity for realistic physics.
+ Added dynamic props(will call them props from now): You can make props from materials to use on your tools or make a base from them.
+ Added Hammer: A tool to weld two objects together.
+ Added Nailmer: A tool to create axis between two objects.
+ Added Cable: A tool to connect two electrical devices (will call them EDevice now). Only works on EDevices.
+ Added Lamp: duh.
+ Added Button
+ Added Battery
+ Added Table: To make props.
- Removed armor (Will come back later)
- Removed inventory (Will come back later)

Wow you accually care a lot about this game if you really did read all that text. Thank you! Contact me if you have any ideas.

notes.title: Re-Work Update
notes.content:
Ladies and Gentlemen, I am happy to announce you... THE RE-WORK UPDATE!

This update comes with 2 new creatures, optimized gameplay, added game mechanics and some changes.
I will explain them all here, don't worry. I know you are hyped up. So, Let's Begin.

Map Optimization

Before the update, Map loading was like trying to walk while having 300 ping with 15 fps. "Okay but why" you may ask. I'll give you a example:

Imagine a guy. Lets name him Duke.
Boss wants Duke to Deliver 100 Messages to 100 House in 1 minute. 
Duke got fired.
Boss learned from his mistake and increased time to 5 minute.
but Duke didn't got his job back...

Long Story Short:
Instead of doing everything in a single-frame, I distrubuted it to multiple frames.

Spawn System

Creatures now spawn constantly at places you are not looking. In my opinion, it makes the world way more alive that way.

Build System

Building blueprints now snap to other buildings for easier and much better rotation.

Save System

Save system got a whole new look! The Save System works properly now! Before the update, There was buildings stuck inside them like a crappy game engine, entities spawn as wrong entities, bla bla bla you know the rest.

World Creation

Psst! Over here! Listen to me. There is a secret panel leading for customizing your world now. Go check it out!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41855136/1d925706726fda3e4d87396280104044af81c60e.png

Character Upgrading

There is now a goal for playing this game! (At least for me.) KEEP PUNCHING TO BE A STRONK MEN, Keep running to be fast like thunder! (oh btw you can see your statictics here too.)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41855136/4241f8c59f88edd007a8e8637c4b290b5a431a67.png 

Item Upgrading & Cooking System

Do you want a over powered Stone? Or Boil your water so you can drink it warm and have a crisis?
Then Booster and Oven is for you!

Booster, boosts (literally) your items by using seperate ores.
Oven just cooks food.

AND NOW....
THE MOST IMPORTANT THING HAS HAPPENED TO UNTITLED SURVIVAL GAME.
NOBODY, ANYBODY, NOT EVEN MANKIND COULD NOT BE PREPARED FOR THIS EVENT.
THE THING IS
i added fish
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41855136/0c5b678b11a09402ac19776c8ce22a37f57f24e0.png

there is full update logs below so you can read it:

+ Re-Wrote and optimized entire loading map script
+ Re-Wrote creature spawn system
+ Re-Wrote Craft System
+ Re-Wrote Build System
+ Re-Wrote Save&Load System.
+ Added Booster
+ Added Fish
+ Added Banana
+ Added Other Build Decorations
+ Added Clouds
+ Added Cooking System
+ Added Auto-Save
+ Added King Grass
- Changed Grass Model and Loot
- Chest mechanic removed.

Thank you all who come this far and supported this game with me.
It really means a lot.
Welp. Thats it.
See you next time!

notes.title: Alive Update
notes.content:
Hello, I am back. Did you miss me?
Today i have came back with a few things. Wait, stop. This is not "Wow these are awesome features" type of update but "Did you seriously made a announcement just for that?" type of update. Lets begin.

4 New creatures added!
These are : Woof,Birb,Treurtle ve Birb Doulder. (Im calling them like this you can call it anything you want.)
I will explain what are they and what do they do, dont worry.

Woof
This friend randomly appears on forest and do not attack unless attacked or hungry.
The most part i love is it is tameable. And no, i will not tell how :d

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41855136/7cbdc33fe842c4cde5a47423a2ab71b51a454f37.jpg
Image 1: Woof.

Birb
You can see this little cute creatures while flying or trying to climb somewhere. If you attack it will have a adrenaline explosion and fly away. Sometimes it drop white balls. I will explain what is it now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41855136/12a4ac0cd7c84055bd0885f6d8c27d5212a15e23.jpg
Image 2: Birb.

Birb Doulder
This thing is a diffrent breed of Doulders that doesn't hurt anything. It just flies the creature it touched.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41855136/5fe0ba9085acbdda7ad46f6fc2d55dbb0bf7b812.jpg
Image 3: Birb Doulder.

Treurtle
This thing is a turtle with tree seed on his shell. First, it finds a good spot to dig itself. then it grows its seed. Then a tree appears..

There is a few changes other than these. I am putting these changes in order down below.

- Changes on Compass.
- Increased chance of tree spawn.

Thank you for your time. It really is important for me.
I will be waiting for your feedback and wishing you good game.

notes.title: "Roast" Update
notes.content:
Hello! You thought this game just died right? Never!
I'm back again for you.
I have come with a new update.
You will get why this update is called "roast".
So, Let's begin!

A Creature Has Awaken...
A Spooky Skeleton! But wait, there is more!
Instead of eating you, It roasts you! How? Join and see.
While this skeleton is annoying just by itself, imagine it with a crowd of them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41855136/231a3b1f32711f486ea5035ad2ea100aac49a8f9.jpg
Picture 1: Skeleroast

A New Mechanic Added!
You better be make a house or sleep at nights.
Because creatures will respawn at night from the ground!
I think fighting with a army of skeletons is not a great idea.

Also, I didn't announce past updates. I will announce them here:

+ Bow projectile speed increased
+ Removed creatures inside arena, added ores instead.
+ Added "Skeleroast".
- Fixed a bug that caused hands to stay at air.
- Fixed a bug that caused items to not drop when pressing Q
- Fixed a bug that caused map to generate another place.
- Reduced change to spawn arena when joining tunnel

So That was all.

I will be waiting for your feedback and wishing you good game!
